method: Outcome-aware November desk reconstruction of predictions inferred from knowledge described in predecision-published 2025–26 quarterly PDUFA lists. Each has efficacy, safety and regulatory hypotheses; DO NOT treat as full audited Level 3/20 scientific adjudication. Prospective performance cannot be calculated.
scope: 38 distinct therapy-indication review cycles on a prepublished Dec 23 Jan list (Jan), Jan 9 Q1 list (Feb-Mar), and Mar 30 Q2 list as of Mar 18 (Apr-May). Partners and duplicate cross-quarter cycles counted once. Source lists are NOT a complete census of all FDA drug reviews or clinical trials Jan-May 2026.
exclusions: Already decided application cycles that appear on the outdated source list are excluded from approval/CRL scoring; later action/extended cycles are not scored as a Jan-May FDA action. Multiple sponsor listings and the same application reposted in April are deduplicated.

reviewCases.level1Efficacy: Rare-disease BLA; biomarker glycosaminoglycan reduction as surrogate, no conventional survival pivotal trial
reviewCases.level2Safety: Accelerated endpoint plausibility with residual surrogate and neurologic benefit uncertainty
reviewCases.level3Regulatory: Priority review and high unmet need; original target later changed

reviewCases.level1Efficacy: Allogeneic EBV-specific T cell therapy with nonrandomized response signal; already EU-authorized
reviewCases.level2Safety: Small rare oncology single-arm program, attribution and durability unresolved
reviewCases.level3Regulatory: 2025 CRL on manufacturing; renewed US BLA carries repeat regulatory-risk exposure

reviewCases.level1Efficacy: DUPLEX Phase 3 proteinuria efficacy reported, but primary eGFR slope endpoint missed
reviewCases.level2Safety: Uncertain full clinical benefit from proteinuria surrogate, known liver and pregnancy safety management
reviewCases.level3Regulatory: Expansion from IgAN label; FDA asked for further analyses, regulatory risk persists

reviewCases.level1Efficacy: Long-marketed enzyme replacement therapy and mechanistically plausible GD3 non-CNS manifestations
reviewCases.level2Safety: Severe rare disease and established adult safety exposure; infant dosing/hypersensitivity risk
reviewCases.level3Regulatory: Supplement with familiar manufacturing and approved product

reviewCases.level1Efficacy: Rare pediatric Menkes disease, nonrandomized early treatment and historical-control survival data
reviewCases.level2Safety: Strong unmet need, severe disease; natural history comparator and toxicity limitations
reviewCases.level3Regulatory: Breakthrough designation and pediatric orphan pathway support regulatory flexibility

reviewCases.application: Enhertu + Perjeta · metastatic HER2+ breast cancer
reviewCases.level1Efficacy: Phase 3 metastatic combination; oncology application
reviewCases.level2Safety: Known fatal interstitial lung disease risk requires scrutiny
reviewCases.level3Regulatory: Pre-December 2025 approval renders January target stale at forecast freeze

reviewCases.level1Efficacy: Epinephrine exposure bridging to auto-injectors rather than direct anaphylaxis efficacy trial
reviewCases.level2Safety: Emergency-use film placement/dose-delivery and human-factors errors are critical even with adequate PK
reviewCases.level3Regulatory: New dosage format to be used by laypeople in emergencies: high human-factors review risk

reviewCases.level1Efficacy: Established older-patient disease activity; small open-label pediatric PK/response bridging
reviewCases.level2Safety: Uncertain pediatric exposure, dosing and neutropenia; sparse safety n
reviewCases.level3Regulatory: Potential dosing and analytical CMC concerns in new pediatric strengths

reviewCases.application: RGX-121 AAV gene therapy · Hunter syndrome
reviewCases.level1Efficacy: Pivotal CAMPSIITE uncontrolled small rare disease dataset; CSF heparan sulfate marker
reviewCases.level2Safety: Clinically meaningful neurologic effect not independently proven by surrogate; CNS gene transfer toxicity
reviewCases.level3Regulatory: Single-arm external-control comparability and surrogate validation are material approval vulnerabilities

reviewCases.application: Keytruda ± Qlex plus chemotherapy · ovarian cancer
reviewCases.level1Efficacy: Randomized KEYNOTE-B96 in platinum-resistant ovarian cancer; PFS with supportive survival signal
reviewCases.level2Safety: Immunotherapy toxicities and PD-L1 selection need label restrictions
reviewCases.level3Regulatory: Already licensed PD-1 therapy and label expansion with pivotal RCT

reviewCases.level1Efficacy: Iloperidone active-metabolite/parent conversion and schizophrenia efficacy bridging
reviewCases.level2Safety: Metabolic, QT and orthostatic effects familiar from related agent
reviewCases.level3Regulatory: NDA with established pharmacology and reference therapy reduces new mechanism risk

reviewCases.application: ET-600 oral desmopressin · central diabetes insipidus
reviewCases.level1Efficacy: Established desmopressin molecule; liquid dosage form with PK bridge
reviewCases.level2Safety: Hyponatremia and fluid intoxication are class risks, especially pediatric dosing
reviewCases.level3Regulatory: 505(b)(2)-style reformulation and established active moiety favor approval if dosing/CMC validated

reviewCases.level1Efficacy: Open-label ASTX727-07 regimen in older AML, limited controls but established separate components
reviewCases.level2Safety: Myelosuppression, infectious complications and limited comparative efficacy data
reviewCases.level3Regulatory: Supplement in high unmet need with accepted response and remission endpoints

reviewCases.level1Efficacy: AIMS controlled study of type 2 airway inflammation; established anti-IL4/13 mechanism
reviewCases.level2Safety: No major new class safety profile, pediatric extrapolation requires review
reviewCases.level3Regulatory: Supplement for marketed biologic, Phase 3 evidence and precedent

reviewCases.level1Efficacy: Phase 3 linear-growth velocity improvement in pediatric achondroplasia
reviewCases.level2Safety: Growth surrogate and long-term skeletal safety unresolved; high disease burden
reviewCases.level3Regulatory: Priority orphan drug review with pivotal growth endpoint

reviewCases.level1Efficacy: Established adult Phe-lowering biological effect; adolescent dose extrapolation with pediatric data
reviewCases.level2Safety: Anaphylaxis risk and injection burden particularly salient in younger patients
reviewCases.level3Regulatory: Marketed enzyme therapy with expansion and known REMS

reviewCases.level1Efficacy: Established approved F18 PSMA-PET tracer with higher concentration manufacturing
reviewCases.level2Safety: Radiochemistry batch consistency and reader-sensitivity comparability need verification
reviewCases.level3Regulatory: Reformulation of established approved diagnostic agent

reviewCases.level1Efficacy: POETYK PsA-1/PsA-2 Phase 3 studies report improved ACR20 vs placebo
reviewCases.level2Safety: Infection, herpes zoster, thrombotic concerns require monitoring; class precedent favorable
reviewCases.level3Regulatory: Approved TYK2 drug label expansion supported by two RCTs

reviewCases.level1Efficacy: Mixed dry-eye signs/symptoms endpoint history, repeated trials, and prior FDA objections
reviewCases.level2Safety: Transient instillation irritation but larger issue is inconsistent evidentiary interpretation
reviewCases.level3Regulatory: Prior CRL, heterogeneous endpoints and possible lack of substantial evidence

reviewCases.level1Efficacy: Randomized Phase 3 TRANSCEND demonstrated substantial BMI reduction vs placebo
reviewCases.level2Safety: Skin hyperpigmentation, GI effects and long-term weight maintenance risk
reviewCases.level3Regulatory: Known MC4R drug with strong Phase 3 expansion signal

reviewCases.level1Efficacy: Randomized GLISTEN showed improvement in validated itch and sleep symptoms
reviewCases.level2Safety: Diarrhea and fat-soluble vitamin effects; no known biliary disease modification
reviewCases.level3Regulatory: Symptoms-focused indication with clinically meaningful patient-reported endpoint

reviewCases.level1Efficacy: Severe rare inherited disease with gene therapy survival/benefit compared with natural history
reviewCases.level2Safety: Autologous product CMC, engraftment and long-term vector safety high
reviewCases.level3Regulatory: Resubmitted BLA after prior manufacturing CRL; reported remediations favor approval but uncertainty remains

reviewCases.level1Efficacy: SSTR diagnostic PET kit and existing medical-imaging rationale; quantitative diagnostic validity not reverified
reviewCases.level2Safety: Radiochemistry kit assembly and batch purity on third-party network
reviewCases.level3Regulatory: NDA CMC/inspection risk; inadequate original trial reader evidence in accessible predecision corpus

reviewCases.level1Efficacy: DEVOTE-like high-dose program and established functional benefit of antisense nusinersen
reviewCases.level2Safety: Intrathecal procedure-related toxicity and higher systemic exposure
reviewCases.level3Regulatory: Higher-dose supplement of long-marketed drug; dose/PK response assessment

reviewCases.level1Efficacy: KEYNOTE-905/EV-303 pivotal randomized bladder-cancer regimen
reviewCases.level2Safety: ADC rash/neuropathy and surgery fitness important
reviewCases.level3Regulatory: Cisplatin-ineligible indication approved November 2025; April listing stale

reviewCases.level1Efficacy: Randomized SWOG S1826 Phase 3 improved PFS over brentuximab+AVD
reviewCases.level2Safety: Immune-related adverse events require surveillance
reviewCases.level3Regulatory: Approved PD-1 with randomized registration trial

reviewCases.level1Efficacy: IGNYTE single-arm study after PD-1 failure; attribution to oncolytic therapy difficult
reviewCases.level2Safety: Heterogeneous cohort, response assessment and intervention confounding
reviewCases.level3Regulatory: 2025 CRL already questioned evidentiary sufficiency; resubmission without randomized confirmatory trial

reviewCases.application: Sarclisa SC via on-body injector · myeloma
reviewCases.level1Efficacy: SC formulation of already approved IV isatuximab, PK bridging and exposure
reviewCases.level2Safety: New on-body device human factors and formulation-site reactions
reviewCases.level3Regulatory: Existing drug with CMC/device comparability, not a new efficacy application

reviewCases.level1Efficacy: Known nimodipine clinical rationale; 505(b)(2) intravenous reformulation
reviewCases.level2Safety: Excipient/packaging leachables toxicity, infusion error and parenteral sterility require validation
reviewCases.level3Regulatory: Novel sterile formulation with CMC-dependent review; risk exceeds benefit extrapolation

reviewCases.level1Efficacy: CUPID controlled adult/adolescent studies and pediatric PK extrapolation
reviewCases.level2Safety: Pediatric dosing/infection risk, but substantial prior pediatric exposure in other indications
reviewCases.level3Regulatory: Supplement for established biologic with Phase 3 data

reviewCases.level1Efficacy: Two-drug HIV suppression noninferiority program in stable treated adults
reviewCases.level2Safety: Islatravir-associated lymphocyte signals at higher doses and resistance concerns
reviewCases.level3Regulatory: Lower dose reformulated after earlier safety setbacks; noninferiority supports defined switch label

reviewCases.level1Efficacy: Existing RCT age ≥8 delayed clinical T1D; extrapolating treatment to younger ages
reviewCases.level2Safety: Cytokine release, infection, blood count changes and pediatric PK uncertainties
reviewCases.level3Regulatory: Existing drug and pediatric expansion; efficacy extrapolation allowed if PK bridge robust

reviewCases.level1Efficacy: Several controlled trials on agitation symptom rating and relapse vs placebo
reviewCases.level2Safety: CNS/neuropsychiatric events, bupropion seizures and drug interaction risks
reviewCases.level3Regulatory: Approved antidepressant label expansion; predefined agitation endpoints and regulatory discussions favorable

reviewCases.level1Efficacy: Randomized ADAPT SERON in AChR-negative MG with symptom benefit
reviewCases.level2Safety: FcRn inhibition lowers IgG and may raise infection risk
reviewCases.level3Regulatory: Previously approved antibody with Phase 3 extension into seronegative patients

reviewCases.application: Enhertu → THP neoadjuvant HER2+ breast cancer
reviewCases.level1Efficacy: DESTINY-Breast11 randomized pCR efficacy; active anti-HER2 standard comparison
reviewCases.level2Safety: Interstitial lung disease, neuropathy and treatment interruptions
reviewCases.level3Regulatory: Approved HER2 ADC expanding to earlier-stage setting on positive Phase 3

reviewCases.level1Efficacy: PK/safety bridging to approved anti-amyloid lecanemab; not another disease-modification RCT
reviewCases.level2Safety: ARIA risk and device autoinjector human factors
reviewCases.level3Regulatory: Supplemental initiation device/formulation with new home-administration risks

reviewCases.level1Efficacy: INHALE-1 pediatric randomized control study and adult licensed prandial insulin precedent
reviewCases.level2Safety: Pulmonary function monitoring, bronchospasm and DKA exposure
reviewCases.level3Regulatory: Postmarketing pediatric study supplement for marketed product

reviewCases.level1Efficacy: Active dexmethylphenidate known, but new controlled-release platform requires precise exposure/dose
reviewCases.level2Safety: Abuse risk, pediatric precision, duration of effect and ingestion hazards
reviewCases.level3Regulatory: February 2026 CMO preapproval inspection with Form 483 documented in March 2026 10-K; CMC failure risk
